claude-code.note: Effort per the model table and default sentences of code.claude.com/docs/en/model-config, dated by the Wayback captures of 2026-06-04 to 2026-10-19 and our fetch of 2026-10-23 (intervals = runs of captures with the same text). Unsupported levels fall back to the highest supported level at or below (xhigh -> high on models without xhigh). Thinking off with xhigh/max on Opus 5 is sent as high (changelog 2.1.251, 2026-08-28; not expressed). Models absent from the table have no effort (no entry).

codex-cli.label: Codex CLI (OpenAI)
codex-cli.note: Effective effort = the user's setting or the model's default_reasoning_level (models-manager/models.json; core/src/session/step_settings.rs), passed through resolve_reasoning_effort, which returns the effort unchanged except ultra (multi-agent) and persistent. Accepts = supported_reasoning_levels per commit of models.json (ultra excluded). Default = default_reasoning_level. Dated by commit dates (Apr-Oct 2026) and the 23 Oct fetch of main.

inspect-ai.label: Inspect AI (UK AISI eval framework)
inspect-ai.note: Harness: its effort mapping is provider-specific in its code (git history, commits dated from the local partial clone of UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_ai): openrouter.py max->xhigh introduced by commit c99fa933 (21 May 2026, reasoning effort mapping #4008) and unchanged since; anthropic.py Opus 5 thinking-disabled clamp introduced by 5cb9da4a (27 Jul 2026, Support for Claude Opus 5); anthropic.py max/xhigh handling by 149f2657 (16 Apr 2026, Support for new max reasoning effort option); OpenAI passthrough line not dated. Code (inspect_ai/model/_providers/*.py, _openai.py, _generate_config.py, read from GitHub UKGovernmentBEIS/inspect_ai main, 23 Oct 2026, no commit dates taken): OpenRouter provider sends max as xhigh (providers/openrouter.py L394-397); OpenAI provider passes reasoning_effort unchanged (_openai.py L620-621); Anthropic provider sends max as high unless Claude frontier and xhigh as high before Claude 4.7 (providers/anthropic.py L1444-1452) and clamps effort above high to high when thinking is disabled (L1496-1514). The mapping depends on the provider behind it, so no route-level mapping is recorded (not established).

pi.label: Pi (earendil-works coding agent)
pi.note: Harness (clampThinkingLevel introduced by commit 80f06d36, 2 May 2026; body not dated line by line): levels map through the model's thinkingLevelMap (per-model table from models.dev / OpenRouter metadata, not in the repository); a requested level not available is clamped upward first (packages/ai/src/models.ts clampThinkingLevel, read from main 23 Oct 2026). Per-model tables not obtained: no entries (not established). Wire logs of 18 Oct 2026 (hn/news-code2a probe) show reasoning_effort = the row's tier for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017; not used as code evidence.

opencode.label: OpenCode (open-source coding agent)
opencode.note: Harness: its variant tiers map to reasoning_effort on the OpenAI-compatible endpoint (wire probe 19 Oct 2026, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, 10 legs per tier). The mapping code (anomalyco/opencode) was not read: not established.

openrouter.note: Accepts = the model's supported_efforts from GET /api/v1/models (none = nothink); default = default_effort where default_enabled is true or mandatory; no-reasoning-object models accept nothink; on-off models (no levels) accept nothink and think. huggingface.note: A namespace for the repository ids of open weights ('Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B'), matched case-insensitively (the Hub resolves repository ids without regard to case). As a route: weights loaded from the Hub and run by the evaluator (Inspect's hf/ provider): self-hosted, engine not stated. Hugging Face Inference Providers (a router) is not this route.
